## Synthesis phase II {#sec-synthesis-2}

::: {.callout-note}

This section still needs to be written. 
The following outline is based on @wouters_ontwerp_2008-1.

:::

This synthesis presents monitoring scenarios matching the previously identified priority monitoring needs (see @tab-mon-scopes).
Summarizing the previous sections, each scenario includes:

- Overview of monitoring questions
- Precise description of target population
- List of required variables
- Description of sampling design and sample size planning 

Scenarios are compared and further refined, 
also on the basis of a cost effectiveness analysis.
